Nietzsche, predicting the age of social media:

> But thus do I counsel you, my friends: distrust all in whom the
> impulse to punish is powerful!

Nietzsche [Thus spake
Zarathustra](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/1998/1998-0.txt), translated by
Thomas Common. Chapter 29. The Tarantulas.
